items.text: $NPCE The selloff prices in execution risk but overlooks the model. Q3 miss traces to likely transitory factors: sales realignment, capacity at a few large centers, SEEG exit. Mgmt says cases were deferred, not lost. Adj. GM 84.8%, adj. EBITDA positive.
